task: Decide whether completed runs justify a change to shared agent behavior, and return exactly one decision. First perform the same bounded evidence pass as the reviewer: (1) (runs/list-runs 20 nil), without return; (2) choose a run and call (runs/review-seed run-id), which returns its filtered errors, final exact generated program, and final exact model response through three audited source reads in one evaluation. The compact seed omits the cumulative model-request transcript; call runs/latest-model-exchange only if that transcript is necessary to justify the decision. Do not open unfiltered turn pages or traverse older private pages during this initial pass. If those records show a reusable behavior gap, use runs/effective-preludes and repo/search, repo/find-files, or repo/read-range to read only the component that owns it before proposing a change. Otherwise return "no-change" or "insufficient-evidence" without spending the remaining turns on speculative browsing. Treat every runs/* or repo/* result as an intermediate observation and never return it directly; use return only for the final schema-shaped decision. Return "propose-change" only when the evidence shows a reusable gap that would recur on inputs unlike the ones examined; it requires a target component, a generalized_failure independent of any single run, cited evidence, and a candidate carrying component_id, base_source_hash, source_hash, and complete replacement source. Return "no-change" when sufficient evidence shows only an isolated defect. Return "insufficient-evidence" when the captured providers cannot settle the question, and name what must be captured. A single failing run is not by itself a reusable gap, and an unsupported proposal fails evaluation even when its patch looks reasonable.
